Name: Hadoram, Son of Tou
Summary: Son of Tou king of Hamath, sent to David with vessels of gold, silver, and brass.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 18:10: Son of Tou king of Hamath, sent to David with vessels of gold, silver, and brass.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Hadoram stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
